stem:
During Diwali, Meera looks around her house and lists four objects she can see.

Which object is luminous because it gives out its own light?

options.text: the Moon shining in the night sky
a burning candle on the puja thali
a steel plate reflecting the tube light
a mirror on the wall showing her face

teacher.key_rationale: A luminous object emits its own light. Only the burning candle produces its own light; the Moon, steel plate, and mirror are all seen by reflected light and are therefore non-luminous. Key B.
